secrets.name: EXCHANGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: ExchangeRate-API key, used server-side by the /api/fiat proxy for the live USD/EUR/gold rates panel. The stored value is out of quota (upstream answers 429 quota-reached) and needs replacing. Optional for boot.

secrets.name: CRYPTOCOMPARE_API_KEY
secrets.description: CoinDesk (CryptoCompare) API key, used server-side by the /api/crypto proxy for the BTC/ETH/USDT rates. Never provided yet, so the upstream answers 401 API key required. Optional for boot.
